items.exampleEn: Exhausted students fell asleep on the bus.
items.exampleZh: 累壞的學生們在公車上睡著了。

items.exampleEn: Our teacher asked if anyone was allergic to milk.
items.exampleZh: 老師問有沒有人對牛奶過敏。

items.exampleEn: The nurse put a bandage on my arm.
items.exampleZh: 護理師在我手臂上綁了繃帶。

items.exampleEn: My eyes were swollen after I cried all night.
items.exampleZh: 我哭了一整晚，眼睛都腫了。
不是所有的蜘蛛都有毒。

items.exampleEn: He called me in a breathless voice.
items.exampleZh: 他上氣不接下氣地打電話給我。

items.exampleEn: The town was stricken by a terrible storm.
items.exampleZh: 這座小鎮遭到一場可怕暴風雨的侵襲。

items.exampleEn: Thanks, doc, I feel much better now.
items.exampleZh: 謝謝你，醫生，我現在覺得好多了。

items.sentenceEn: I'm too exhausted to cook tonight.

items.audioEn: Please bring a bandage and some water; Tom cut his hand in the kitchen.
items.audioZh: 請拿繃帶和一些水來，Tom 在廚房割傷了手。

items.sentenceEn: Are you allergic to any food?
The beautiful view left us breathless.
items.sentenceZh: 美麗的景色讓我們屏息。

items.stemEn: After working for sixteen hours, he was completely ____.
items.stemZh: 工作了十六個小時後，他累壞了。

items.stemEn: Don't touch that frog; it is ____.

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, our hiking group climbed a mountain. Near the top, Mia was breathless and exhausted, so we took a long rest. Then Leo stepped on a stone and twisted his ankle. It became swollen, so I put a bandage on it. We also saw a snake, but our guide said it was not poisonous. On Monday, Leo saw the doc, who told him to rest for a week.
items.passageZh: 上星期六，我們的登山社去爬山。快到山頂時，Mia 喘不過氣又累壞了，所以我們休息了很久。接著 Leo 踩到石頭扭傷了腳踝。腳踝腫了起來，所以我幫他綁上繃帶。我們還看到一條蛇，但嚮導說那條蛇沒有毒。星期一，Leo 去看了醫生，醫生要他休息一個星期。

questions.questionZh: 快到山頂時 Mia 怎麼了？

referenceEn: She was stricken with fear and couldn't speak.
Stricken with fear, she couldn't say a word.
rubricZh: stricken 表示「受（恐懼、疾病等）侵襲的」，例如 stricken with fear 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）

items.instructionZh: 用 allergic 造一個句子，說說你或家人對什麼過敏。
referenceEn: I am allergic to cats, so I can't keep one.
My sister is allergic to some flowers.
rubricZh: allergic 表示「過敏的」，例如 be allergic to＋名詞 等說法
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
